name: What is the process for getting new flooring installed?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting new flooring installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our flooring installation process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your needs, preferences, and budget. Next, we conduct an on-site assessment to measure the area, inspect the subfloor, and confirm material requirements. Following this, we provide a detailed quote. Once approved, we schedule the installation. The project involves removing old flooring, preparing the subfloor, installing the new material, and finally, a thorough clean-up and final inspection. We aim to keep you informed at every stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes consultation, on-site assessment, detailed quote, old flooring removal, subfloor prep, new material installation, and final clean-up.
